notes.title: Trellis Roadmap
notes.excerpt: Quarterly themes for local-first knowledge capture.
notes.markdown_body:
---
title: Trellis Roadmap
tags: [product, roadmap]
type: concept
---
A running map of bets that compound the product. Links to [[Local First Principles]] and [[Notes From Chats]].

## Q2 bets
- Make first-run value legible within the first session.
- Make extracted notes easier to trust and edit.
- Make local-versus-cloud boundaries obvious.

notes.title: Local First Principles
notes.excerpt: Why user-owned vaults matter for trust and speed.
notes.markdown_body:
---
title: Local First Principles
tags: [research]
type: concept
---
Local-first software keeps the authoritative copy on the device. Cloud is for sync and backup, not the primary read path.

See [[Trellis Roadmap]] for how this shows up in product bets.

notes.title: Notes From Chats
notes.excerpt: Patterns extracted from recent assistant conversations.
notes.markdown_body:
---
title: Notes From Chats
tags: [synthesis]
type: synthesis
---
Chat sessions are a rich source of provisional notes. Trellis promotes the durable ones into the vault.

Referenced in [[Trellis Roadmap]] and the Preview Workspace seed sessions.

notes.title: Trust Signals
notes.excerpt: What makes extracted notes feel safe to keep.
notes.markdown_body:
---
title: Trust Signals
tags: [product]
type: concept
---
Provenance, edit history, and obvious source links help users trust automated extractions.

notes.title: Preview Workspace
notes.excerpt: The editable sandbox shipped with Trellis desktop.
notes.markdown_body:
---
title: Preview Workspace
tags: [product]
type: entity
---
The preview workspace is an isolated vault with seeded chats and notes. Reset restores the shipped fixture.

chatMessages.content: Summarize the themes in [[Trellis Roadmap]] for a design partner email.
The roadmap centers on first-run clarity, trustworthy extractions, and obvious data boundaries — all tied to [[Local First Principles]].
What patterns should become notes from our last three chats?
Promote provenance cues into [[Trust Signals]] and link the synthesis in [[Notes From Chats]].
